## Results reported against interest

**N1 - distribution loses to centralization under partition.** Survivors: `centralized`, `full_replication`. All 6 other strategies score 0.00, including every distributed one. Keeping every premise on one node is what survives a partition; that is the real cost of distribution.

**N2 - lineage-aware repair does not dominate.** It loses to `source_count` in exactly 1 of 6 cells: `lineage_aware::node_failure::I1`. With a single independent root there is no independent holder to find, so refusing every correlated holder discards a replica that would have served.

**C5 - min-cut predicts survival.** Under `worst_single_domain_failure`, which fails exactly one domain and never a whole cut, only `oracle_min_cut` survives -- the only placement with a minimum failure-domain cut of 2.
